segments.text: Lie down, and let your whole body grow still. There is nothing left for you to do tonight but rest.
Breathe in slowly through your nose. And let it go, soft and long.
With each breath, you are sinking. Down, and down, into the quiet.
Picture a calm, dark place. Still water under a night sky. Nothing stirring.
You float there, weightless, held. Safe in the dark.
Let your breath grow slower. There is no rush. Time has gone soft.
Every muscle releasing. Every thought dissolving into the water.
Heavier now. Warmer. Drifting further from the day behind you.
If your mind wanders, that's alright. Let it wander itself to sleep.
You are deeply calm. Deeply safe. Carried on slow, dark water.
Nothing to reach for. Nothing to fix. Only this quiet, only this rest.
Let the last of your waking thoughts fade out, like a light dimming low.
Rest now, completely. I'll hold the silence. Sleep deeply, and sleep well.
